notes.title: Bouncemasters Demo Next Fest Challenge: Penguin-Launching Leaderboard!
notes.content: [h3]Think you’re the ultimate penguin-launcher? It’s time to prove it! [/h3][p]During the Next Fest (June 9–16), everyone is invited to climb to the top of the Bouncemasters Demo leaderboard.  [/p][p][/p][p]When the event ends on June 16, our three most legendary bouncers will earn some sweet loot:[/p][p]🥇 1st Place – $25 Steam Gift Card  [/p][p]🥈 2nd Place – $10 Steam Gift Card  [/p][p]🥉 3rd Place – $5 Steam Gift Card[/p][p][/p][p]No cheating, just pure flipper-powered arcade skill and maybe a little bit of penguin luck.  [/p][p][b]Ready, set… BOUNCE![/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]And don't forget to join our [url="https://discord.gg/8kDBMSf7VF"]discord[/url] - we are building a sweet-little-pengu community there![/i][/p]

notes.title: Bouncemasters Demo on Steam Next Fest - LIVE!
notes.content: [h3]We're thrilled to announce that demo of the classic Bouncemasters game is featured in the Steam Next Fest: June Edition![/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3774120/Bouncemasters_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]🔥 Already a massive hit on other platforms with 300+ million downloads worldwide - Bouncemasters is launching in full on Steam in Q3 2025!  [/p][p][/p][p]👉 Join our [url="https://discord.gg/8kDBMSf7VF"]Bouncemasters Discord[/url] and become part of our Pengu Club!  [/p][p]During Next Fest, we will be hosting:[/p][p]⦁ Huge giveaway for all Discord members[/p][p]⦁ A Leaderboard Contest - compete for the best score![/p][p]⦁ A Screenshot Contest - share your funniest moments from the game![/p][p][/p][p][b]We can’t wait to see your best bounces and most epic fails! See you at Next Fest! 🐧❄️[/b][/p][p][/p][p]✏️ ❤️ Wishlist the full Bouncemasters game - your Wishlist truly BounceMATTERS!
